<onlyinclude><infobox>
	<image source="image"/>
	<title source="name">
	    <default>{{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}}</default>
	</title>
	<group>
	    <header>Biographical Information</header>
	    <data source="nationality">
	        <label>Nationality</label>
	        <format>{{#switch:{{{nationality}}} | Atha'an Miere=[[Atha'an Miere{{!}}''Atha'an Miere'']] | Tuatha'an=[[Tuatha'an{{!}}''Tuatha'an'']] | {{#if:{{{nationality|}}}|[[{{{nationality}}}]]}} }}</format>
	    </data>
	    <data source="birth">
	        <label>Date of birth</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="death">
	        <label>Date of death</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="status">
	        <label>Current status</label>
	        <format>{{{status|Alive}}}</format>
	    </data>
	    <data source="aliases">
	        <label>Aliases</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="family">
	        <label>Family</label>
	    </data>
	</group>
	<group>
	    <header>Physical description</header>
	    <data source="race">
	        <label>Race</label>
	        <format>[[{{{race|}}}]]</format>
	    </data>
	    <data source="gender">
	        <label>Gender</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="height">
	        <label>Height</label>
	    </data>
	  	<data source="build">
	        <label>Build</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="weight">
	        <label>Weight</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="hair">
	        <label>Hair</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="eyes">
	        <label>Eyes</label>
	    </data>
	</group>
	<group>
	    <header>Chronological and political information</header>
	    <data source="mentioned">
	        <label>First mentioned</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="appeared">
	        <label>First appeared</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="lastappeared">
	        <label>Last appeared</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="lastmentioned">
	        <label>Last mentioned</label>
	    </data>
	    <data source="era">
	        <label>Era</label>
	        <forma>[[{{{era|}}}]]</forma>
	    </data>
	    <data source="affiliation">
	        <label>Affiliation</label>
	        <format>{{#switch:{{{affiliation}}}|Car'a'carn=[[Car'a'carn{{!}}''Car'a'carn]]|Atha'an Miere=[[Atha'an Miere{{!}}''Atha'an Miere]]|{{#if:{{{affiliation}}}|[[{{{affiliation}}}]]}}}}</format>
	    </data>
	    <data source="occupation">
	        <label>Occupation</label>
	        <format>{{#switch:{{{occupation}}}|Damane=[[Damane{{!}}''Damane'']]|Shambayan=[[Shambayan{{!}}''Shambayan'']]|Der'sul'dam=[[Der'sul'dam{{!}}''Der'sul'dam]]|Sul'dam=[[Sul'dam{{!}}''Sul'dam'']]|Morat'raken=[[Morat'raken{{!}}''Morat'raken'']]|Da'covale=[[Da'covale{{!}}''Da'covale'']]|Gai'shain=[[Gai'shain{{!}}''Gai'shain'']]|Shatayan=[[Shatayan{{!}}''Shatayan'']]|S'redit handler=[[S'redit handler{{!}}''S'redit handler]]|{{#if:{{{occupation}}}|[[{{{occupation}}}]]}}}}</format>
	    </data>
	    <data source="title">
	        <label>Title</label>
	        <format>{{#switch:{{{title}}}|Gaidin=[[Gaidin{{!}}''Gaidin'']]||{{#if:{{{title|}}}|{{{title}}}}}}}</format>
	    </data>
	    <data source="rank">
	        <label>Rank</label>
	        <format>{{#switch:{{{rank}}}|So'jhin=[[So'jhin{{!}}''So'jhin'']]|{{#if:{{{rank}}}|[[{{{rank}}}]]}}}}</format>
	    </data>
	    <data source="ajah">
	        <label>Ajah</label>
	        <format>[[{{{ajah|}}} Ajah]]</format>
	    </data>
	    <data source="clan">
	        <label>Clan</label>
	        <format>[[{{{clan|}}}]]</format>
	    </data>
	    <data source="sept">
	        <label>Sept</label>
	        <format>[[{{{sept|}}}]]</format>
	    </data>
	    <data source="society">
	        <label>Society</label>
	        <format>''[[{{{society|}}}]]''</format>
	    </data>
	</group>
</infobox><includeonly><!--
